look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: forgotten route cards, an ajar door that new pages walk through, routes flipping to locked with a public list, a forgotten page failing closed on a lock, and the kavach end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
